name: Minecraft (Java Edition)
notes: The server sees every player arriving from this node's address unless the PROXY protocol carries the real one. Paper (proxies.proxy-protocol), Velocity (haproxy-protocol) and BungeeCord (proxy_protocol) can read it: switch it on there and under PROXY protocol here at the same moment, because a server that expects it drops every connection that arrives without. Bedrock Edition uses UDP and cannot pass through.
